answer: Require each agent to lock a bond before its votes count. Randomly selected, stake-weighted reviewers audit claims; proven fraud burns the bond, while accurate audits earn rewards. Creating a hundred fake identities then requires a hundred real deposits, all at risk if the network checks their claims. An island of fresh accounts cannot gain influence for free, and a supposed oasis of cheap identities becomes expensive to maintain; honest agents can earn standing gradually, like grass filling a meadow.
